evals.title: Platform never depends on use case
evals.rule: No PLATFORM node calls, depends on, implements, or imports a USECASE node or module.
evals.check_method: cg check (G01) + grep imports in platform code paths for use-case packages.

evals.title: No component dependency cycles
evals.rule: Component dependencies (declared DEPENDS and actual cross-component calls/imports) form a DAG.
evals.check_method: cg check (G02) + import graph of the changed component.

evals.title: Only declared dependencies
evals.rule: Every cross-component call or import in code matches a DEPENDS edge between the components.
evals.check_method: cg check (G03); compare imports in code_path with cg node get <component> depends_out.

evals.title: Depend on abstractions across components
evals.rule: Cross-component calls target an INTERFACE or SERVICE_CLASS, never another component's concrete CLASS internals (shared UTILITY_CLASS and CONFIG_CLASS nodes and the kernel's frozen shared value types, core.domain_models, are allowed).
evals.check_method: cg check (G04) + read imports.

evals.title: Use cases plug in, platform stays closed
evals.rule: The change adds use-case behaviour through a platform extension point; platform files are untouched unless an accepted ADR covers them.
evals.check_method: cg task get <T> nodes vs layer; cg metrics platform_maturity; git diff of platform paths.

evals.title: Graph matches code
evals.rule: Every implemented class is a node with the correct code_path, and every cross-class call in code is a CALLS edge with the same function name and signature.
evals.check_method: Read the code at code_path; compare with cg node get <id> calls_out/calls_in.

evals.title: Single responsibility
evals.rule: The class does what its business_intent says and nothing else; unrelated logic lives in its own node.
evals.check_method: Read the class against cg node get <id> business_intent.

evals.title: Declared extension point is real
evals.rule: The pattern named in the node's extensibility field is implemented, so the anticipated extension needs no edits to this class.
evals.check_method: Describe the files an anticipated new use case would touch; must match the extensibility claim.

evals.title: Explicit interface contracts
evals.rule: Public functions have typed parameters/returns, documented error behaviour, and do not leak implementation types (DB rows, framework objects) across the boundary.
evals.check_method: Read public signatures of the node; compare with the CALLS edge signatures.

evals.title: Configuration is data
evals.rule: Business parameters (limits, amounts, frequencies, thresholds) come from CONFIG_CLASS objects, not constants in logic.
evals.check_method: Grep the node for numeric literals in business logic.

evals.title: No speculative generality
evals.rule: Every abstraction has either two implementations or a declared extension point in the graph.
evals.check_method: For each interface/base class added, find its IMPLEMENTS edges or extensibility entry.

evals.title: Dependencies are injected
evals.rule: Collaborators (ports, clock, RNG, config) are passed in, not constructed or imported as globals inside business logic.
evals.check_method: Read constructors and module-level state.

evals.title: Contract functions are unit tested
evals.rule: Every function with an incoming CALLS edge has unit tests for normal, boundary and error cases, and the tests pass.
evals.check_method: Map calls_in functions to tests; run the test command.

evals.title: Honest size and complexity
evals.rule: Recorded loc matches cg scan-loc within 10% and the complexity self-assessment follows the rubric; complexity <= max_complexity.
evals.check_method: cg scan-loc; cg check G07/G09; read the code.

evals.title: Utilities reused and registered
evals.rule: No helper duplicates a registered utility; new shared helpers are registered with cg util add.
evals.check_method: cg util find <keywords> for each helper in the diff.

evals.title: Errors handled at boundaries
evals.rule: No bare or silent excepts; failures at I/O boundaries are handled or surfaced with context.
evals.check_method: Grep for except/catch; read handlers.

evals.title: Implements the acceptance criteria
evals.rule: Behaviour matches the task's business context and acceptance criteria exactly (numbers, limits, rounding, ordering).
evals.check_method: cg task get <T>; trace each criterion to code and a test.

evals.title: Business invariants enforced and tested
evals.rule: Invariants stated in the requirement (caps, eligibility, frequency) are enforced in code and covered by tests, including edge and concurrent cases.
evals.check_method: List invariants from the requirement; find the enforcing code and the test for each.

evals.title: Validate at trust boundaries
evals.rule: Inputs from APIs, feeds, files and UIs are validated (type, range, size) before use.
evals.check_method: Identify entry points in the node; read validation.

evals.title: No secrets, minimal PII in logs
evals.rule: No credentials in code or config files; logs do not contain secrets and minimise personal identifiers.
evals.check_method: Grep for keys/passwords/tokens; read log statements.

evals.title: No injection or unsafe deserialisation
evals.rule: Queries are parameterised; no eval/exec/pickle/yaml.load on untrusted data; no shell with untrusted input.
evals.check_method: Grep for execute(, eval(, pickle, yaml.load, subprocess with shell=True.

evals.title: Security-relevant randomness via injectable CSPRNG
evals.rule: Randomness that decides money, rewards or security outcomes uses a cryptographically secure or certified RNG behind an injectable seam (deterministic in tests).
evals.check_method: Grep for random.; confirm the RNG port and its production adapter.

evals.title: Hot paths are constant-cost
evals.rule: Per-event/per-request paths do no blocking I/O, no unbounded scans and no N+1 calls.
evals.check_method: Trace the per-event call chain through CALLS edges; read each hop.

evals.title: Bounded memory
evals.rule: Caches, histories and queues are bounded (size or time window) or explicitly justified.
evals.check_method: Find collections that grow per event; check eviction.

evals.title: Expensive lookups cached or batched
evals.rule: Config/eligibility lookups called per event are cached with a defined invalidation, or batched.
evals.check_method: Read callers of repository/port functions on the hot path.

evals.title: Shared types are visible in the graph
evals.rule: Every import of another node's shared type (domain models, config classes) is recorded as a USES edge, so cg impact shows its real blast radius.
evals.check_method: grep 'from <package>.<component>.' imports in each code_path; compare with the node's USES/CALLS edges.

evals.title: Concrete adapters only in composition roots
evals.rule: Concrete adapters (clocks, RNGs, buses, databases, repositories) are constructed only in declared composition roots and tests; elsewhere they arrive through their ports.
evals.check_method: grep for adapter constructors (e.g. SeededRng(, SystemClock(, InMemoryEventBus(, Sqlite*() outside the composition root and tests.

evals.title: Contract lists the public surface
evals.rule: Every public method of a SERVICE_CLASS or INTERFACE appears in its node's contract field.
evals.check_method: Compare public methods (inspect) with the contract text.
